newsitem.title: HONG KONG: D&P cuts Tri Polyta unit's ratings.
newsitem.headline: D&P cuts Tri Polyta unit's ratings.

text.p: Duff and Phelps said on Thursday that it has downgraded the senior secured notes of Tri Polyta Finance BV to B-plus from BB-minus.
The notes of Tri Polyta Finance BV are irrevocably and unconditionally guaranteed by PT Tri Polyta Indonesia.

Duff and Phelps said the downgrade is in response to significantly weaker than company-forecasted credit measures due in part from an extended and more severe downturn in the polypropylene markets in Southeast Asia, with higher propylene feedstock costs and lower polypropylene prices.

While the company has taken steps to offset the current weakness and negative cash flow situation, the possibility of an extended decline in the polypropylene market could further pressure already weak credit statistics and lead to a further ratings downgrade, D&P said.
